question: What is the ratio of net income of d10 to d1 group of Singapore in 2015?
query: SELECT      i.gini_reported AS gini_d1,     i.gini_recalculated AS gini_d10,     COALESCE(         (i.gdp_ppp_pc_usd2011 * p.population) /          (s.i.gini_reported * s.i.population), NULL     ) AS net_income_ratio_d10_to_d1 FROM country_income i JOIN country_income s    ON s.ref = 'sing1965' WHERE      s.country = 'SINGAPORE' AND     s.year = 2015 AND     i.category = 'd1' AND     s.i.category = 'd10' LIMIT 50;
